name: create_project
description: Creates a new Dart or Flutter project.

directory.description: The subdirectory in which to create the project, must be a relative path.

empty.description: Whether or not to create an "empty" project with minimized boilerplate and example code. Defaults to true.

platform.description: The list of platforms this project supports. Only valid for Flutter projects. The allowed values are `web`, `linux`, `macos`, `windows`, `android`, `ios`. Defaults to creating a project for all platforms.

root.description: This must be equal to or a subdirectory of one of the roots allowed by the client. Must be a URI with a `file:` scheme (e.g. file:///absolute/path/to/root).
root.title: The file URI of the project root to run this tool in.
